description: A designer psychedelic that does not do gentle. Roll the dice.

events.text: [trip]It comes on too fast and wrong, like a lift dropping. Your heart is suddenly very loud.[/trip]
[trip]The walls are the wrong colour. They know they are the wrong colour. They are furious about it.[/trip]
[trip]Your reflection in every surface is a half-second behind you, and grinning.[/trip]
[trip]Something enormous is screaming just below the range of hearing and it is getting closer.[/trip]
[trip]The floor tilts. The ceiling drips. None of it is trying to help you.[/trip]
[trip]You are being watched by the architecture and it does not like what it sees.[/trip]
[trip]For a moment you are certain you have always been here and will never leave.[/trip]
[trip]The screaming pulls back, inch by inch, but you can still feel exactly where it was.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: It does not ease in. It kicks the door off its hinges.

phases.comedown_message: The worst of it drains away, leaving you shaking and drenched and unconvinced it's really gone.
phases.comeup_message: Your pulse spikes and the room lurches. This one isn't going to be kind.
phases.end_message: You surface. The walls are just walls. You keep checking anyway.
phases.peak_message: There's no floor under this. You're in it, and it's in you.

withdrawal.message: The parts of it that were not real have not agreed to stop being in the room.

stages.easing: It thins out to an ordinary room and one wrong shape, and the wrong shape can be argued with.
stages.onset: You check the corner of the room. There is nothing in the corner of the room.
stages.peak: Something is standing at the edge of your vision with the patience of furniture, and turning your head only puts it in the other eye.
stages.rising: You check it again about every four minutes, and you have started doing it without deciding to.
stages.tail: Walls are walls. You have got it down to checking the once, on the way past.

name: screamers
